rows.purpose: Readable baseline matching one CUDA thread per output element.
Shows tile reuse and accumulation shape before moving to shared memory.
Vendor/library-style reference for correctness and scale contrast.

shared_memory_gemm.finding: A 8x8 tile raises modeled arithmetic intensity from 0.2462 to 1.7778 FLOP/byte and cuts modeled global-memory traffic by 86.154%.

cuda.boundary: CUDA source is present, but compiling/running requires the NVIDIA CUDA toolkit and a visible CUDA device.

boundary: This lab focuses on the shared-memory GEMM idea that sits between naive CUDA matmul and CUTLASS/Tensor Core kernels. Local CPU proxy numbers prove correctness and reuse math; CUDA timing is recorded only when the machine can compile and run it.
